get.description: Named events: `task.progress` (TaskProgress), `inbox.new` (InboxItem), `job.state` (JobState), `log` (LogLine), `account.state` (AccountStateChange). Each frame's data is the JSON payload.

patch.summary:
Update settings with a JSON merge patch (RFC 7396) over [`Settings`]; `null` resets a setting
to its default. Nothing is stored unless the whole result is valid.

400.description: The patch is not a JSON object

422.description: A value is invalid or a setting unknown; `field` names it

post.summary:
Preview the rename templates of a (possibly unsaved) `saveto` group on a sample series, the
way downloads will name their folders and files.

get.summary: Every loaded module, sorted by ID.
A module's options, limits and overrides.

404.description: No module with that ID is loaded

patch.summary:
Update a module's settings with a JSON merge patch (RFC 7396) over `enabled`, `limits`,
`http` and `options` (option values keyed by `key`; `null` resets one to its default).
Nothing is stored unless the whole patch is valid.

400.description: The patch is not a JSON object

404.description: No module with that ID is loaded

422.description: A value is invalid or a setting unknown; `field` names it

get.summary: The accounts of every module with account support, by module ID.

put.summary:
Change a module's username, password or enabled flag. New credentials make the status
`unknown` until the next login. Turning the account on or off runs the module's
`OnAccountState`.

404.description: No loaded module with account support has that ID

409.description: A login of the account is running

delete.summary: Clear a module's credentials and cookies and turn its account off.

404.description: No loaded module with account support has that ID

409.description: A login of the account is running

post.summary:
Log in with the module's `OnLogin`, then its `OnAccountState`; answers once the login is
done, with the status the module set. `account.state` events announce the start and the end.

404.description: No loaded module with account support has that ID

409.description: The module has no login, or a login is already running

JobPhase.description: What a background job is doing.

JobState.description:
A background job and its progress (`job.state`, and the items of `GET /api/jobs`): favorites
check, list update, module update, or any other registered job.

last_run.description: RFC 3339 start of the last run.

next_run.description: RFC 3339 start of the next scheduled run.

LogLevel.description:
Severity of a log line, most severe first. Serialized in upper case; `?level=` also takes
lower case.

LogLine.description: One log line, as FMD2's log window shows it (mangadownloader/forms/frmLogger.pas).

module.description:
The website module that logged the line (the `module` field `fmd.logger` adds,
baseunits/lua/LuaLogger.pas:15-46).

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number; pass the last one seen as `GET /api/logs?since=`.

git_revision.description: The git commit the binary was built from, when known.

load_failures.description: Module files that failed to load.

tools.description: External tools modules and conversions rely on.

upstream_ref.description: The upstream ref the Lua tree follows (e.g. `master`).

upstream_sha.description: The upstream commit the Lua tree was last synced to.

DatabaseSize.description: The size of one database in the data dir.

bytes.description: The database file plus its write-ahead log; `null` when the file does not exist.

LoadFailure.description: A module file that failed to load (`Init` error or unknown Host API).

ToolCheck.description: The outcome of checking one tool.

detail.description: Its version or address when usable, otherwise why not.

field.description:
The setting a validation error (422) is about, as a dotted path such as
`connections.timeout_secs` or `options.server`.

type.description: Always `about:blank`: the status code says it all.

link.description: Series link relative to the module's RootURL

always_start_from_failed_chapters.description:
Restart a task from its failed chapters (`connections/AlwaysStartFromFailedChapters`,
baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:137).

auto_retry_failed_tasks.description:
Times a failed task is restarted automatically (`connections/NumberOfAutoRetryFailedTask`,
`OptionRetryFailedTask` = 1, baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:136). Range 0..=100, the TSpinEdit default (no bounds
set, mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.lfm:3669-3681).

flaresolverr_url.description:
FlareSolverr's URL, e.g. `http://flaresolverr:8191`, for Cloudflare challenges; empty
for none. No FMD2 setting: FMD2r writes it into upstream's
`lua/websitebypass/websitebypass_config.json` at startup
([`write_websitebypass_config`](super::write_websitebypass_config)).

max_parallel_tasks.description:
Tasks downloading at once, over all modules (`connections/NumberOfTasks`,
`OptionMaxParallel` = 1, baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:133). Range 1..=64: the Win64
`MAX_TASKLIMIT` (baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:42), so any FMD2 value imports.

max_update_list_threads.description:
Threads updating manga lists (`connections/MaxUpdateListThreads`,
baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:131). Range 1..=32 (mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.lfm:3827-3828).

threads_per_task.description:
Page download threads per task (`connections/NumberOfThreadsPerTask`, `OptionMaxThreads`
= 1, baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:134). Range 1..=256: the Win64 `MAX_CONNECTIONPERHOSTLIMIT`
(baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:43).

timeout_secs.description:
Connection timeout in seconds (`connections/ConnectionTimeout`, `OptionConnectionTimeout`
= 30, baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:129). Range 1..=300
(mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.lfm:3387-3388).

user_agent.description:
Default user agent; an empty value resets to [`DEFAULT_USER_AGENT`]
(`connections/DefaultUserAgent`, mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.pas:5867-5871).
user_agent.default: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/133.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

CoverSettings.description:
The cover proxy's disk cache (`/api/covers`). No FMD2 counterpart: FMD2 keeps the one cover it
shows in memory (baseunits/uGetMangaInfosThread.pas:168-191).

cache_size_mb.description:
Size cap of the cover cache in MiB; least recently used covers are evicted past it.
Minimum 1.

revalidate_after_hours.description:
Hours a cached cover is served before the site is asked whether it changed; 0 asks every
time.

auto_download.description: Queue new chapters automatically (`update/AutoCheckFavAutoDownload`, default false).

add_as_stopped.description:
Add new tasks stopped instead of waiting (`general/AddAsStopped`,
mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.pas:5819).

data_dir.description:
Folder for the list databases, relative to the app data directory (`DATA_FOLDER`,
baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:285).

lua_dir.description: Folder holding the Lua tree (`LUA_REPO_FOLDER`, baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:297).

cookies.description:
Cookies merged into every request (`HTTP.Cookies`,
baseunits/WebsiteModulesSettings.pas:41).

user_agent.description: Replaces the default user agent when non-empty.

LimitOverrides.description:
Limit overrides; 0 means "not overridden" for tasks and threads
(baseunits/WebsiteModulesSettings.pas:81-83).

max_connection_limit.description:
Replaces the module's connection limit while enabled, 0 (unlimited) included
(baseunits/WebsiteModulesSettings.pas:126-155).

ModuleLimits.description:
The limits a module declares (`MaxTaskLimit`, `MaxThreadPerTaskLimit`, `MaxConnectionLimit`
on the Lua `MODULE` object); 0 means unlimited.

ModuleOptionSetting.description:
One declared option, its default and the value `MODULE.GetOption` returns for it.

`key` is the name the value is stored and patched under.

enabled.description: Whether `limits` and `http` apply (`Settings.Enabled`); options always do.

module_limits.description: The limits the module itself declares; 0 means unlimited.

options.description: The options the module declares with `AddOption*`, in declaration order.

ModuleSummary.description: A loaded module, for the module pickers.

list_job_running.description: Whether a list update or import of it is running.

list_updated.description: RFC 3339 time its list last changed through an update or import.

option_count.description: How many options the module declares.

ModuleUpdaterSettings.description:
Lua module sync from GitHub. The repo defaults are FMD2's `GitHub` section
(dist/config.json:8-15).

auto_update.description:
Sync at startup and on the interval. No FMD2 counterpart: FMD2 checks when the user
clicks "Check update" (`btCheckUpdateClick`, mangadownloader/forms/frmLuaModulesUpdater.pas:70).

github_token.description: Optional GitHub token to raise the API rate limit. No FMD2 counterpart.

interval_minutes.description: Minutes between syncs. No FMD2 counterpart. Minimum 1.

keep_last_good.description:
Keep the previous version of a module that fails to load after an update. No FMD2
counterpart.

pdf_quality.description:
JPEG quality of PDF pages (`saveto/PDFQuality`, default 100,
mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.pas:5888). Range 5..=100
(mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.lfm:4245-4246).

ProxySettings.description:
Global proxy. Unlike FMD2 (which encrypts `User`/`Pass` with `EncryptString`), the
credentials are stored as plain JSON in `app.db`.

RenamePreview.description: The names the rename templates of a draft produce for a sample series.

chapter.description: The chapter folder or archive name (`chapter_rename`).

filename.description: The first page's file name, without extension (`filename_rename`).

SaveToSettings.description:
Where and under which names downloads are saved. The templates take the tokens `%MANGA%`,
`%CHAPTER%`, `%NUMBERING%`, `%WEBSITE%`, `%AUTHOR%`, `%ARTIST%` and `%FILENAME%`
(baseunits/uBaseUnit.pas:251-257); an empty template resets to its default
(mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.pas:5894-5917).

default_dir.description:
Download directory; empty resets to the default (`saveto/SaveTo`, `DEFAULT_PATH`,
baseunits/FMDOptions.pas:283, mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.pas:5882-5886).

oneOf.description:
Which characters are stripped from names. FMD2 always strips the Windows set
(`RemoveSymbols`, baseunits/uBaseUnit.pas:1382); FMD2r runs on Linux and defaults to
POSIX.

replace_unicode.description:
Replace non-ASCII characters in names (`saveto/ChangeUnicodeCharacter`, default false,
mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.pas:5890).

ServerSettings.description: The HTTP server. No FMD2 counterpart.

auth_token.description: Password/bearer token clients must present; `None` disables auth. Stored as plain JSON.

Settings.description: Every application setting. Stored one group per key in `app.db`'s `settings` table.

default.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/133.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

SymbolMode.description: How characters that are illegal in file names are handled (mirrors `fmd_pack::SymbolMode`).

auto_update.description:
Update the selected modules' lists on a timer. No FMD2 counterpart (FMD2 only updates
lists on demand); off by default.

interval_hours.description: Hours between automatic list updates. No FMD2 counterpart. Minimum 1.

new_manga_days.description:
Days a list entry counts as new (`update/NewMangaTime`, default 1,
mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.pas:5953). Range 1..=365
(mangadownloader/forms/frmMain.lfm:2950-2951).

XPathSettings.description: Module XPath evaluation. No FMD2 counterpart: FMD2 always uses its own engine.

AccountInfo.description: A module's account. The password is never returned; `has_password` says whether one is set.

AccountRequest.description:
The fields to change; a missing field keeps its value. Not `Debug`, so the password cannot
be logged.

AccountStateChange.description: An account's status changed (`account.state`): a login started or finished.

FacetValue.description: How many matching titles carry a genre or status.

ListEvent.description: One step of a list job, for the Discover page's progress (`job.lists.<kind>` events).

done.description: Work items of the current step done.

status_text.description: FMD2's status text, or the module's own.

titles.description: Titles added (update) or imported (import), once finished.

total.description: Work items of the current step; 0 when unknown.

ListEventKind.description: What happened to a list job.

ListFacets.description: The genres and statuses of the titles a search matches, most common first.

ListItem.description: One title of a module's list.

added_jdn.description: Julian day number of the day the title was first listed.

link.description: The title's link without the module's host, as the series page takes it.

status.description: As in the `status` filter; empty when unknown.

ListJobStarted.description: A list job that was started.

ModuleCapabilities.description: What a module can do, from the callbacks and flags it declares.

account.description: It has an account to log in with (`AccountSupport`).

info.description: It reads manga info: it declares `OnGetInfo` (`InformationAvailable` aside).

update_list.description: Its list can be updated: it declares `OnGetNameAndLink`.
